Alphabet Inc. (GOOGL) — Q2 2026 forecast update from a frozen prior model.

Our house model for Alphabet was frozen on 2026-01-30. It carries Q2 2026 (2026-04-01 to 2026-06-30) forecasts for consolidated revenues, Google Cloud revenues and diluted EPS, plus FY2026 (2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31) capital expenditure and diluted share-count assumptions. Use these stipulated house-model inputs frozen on 2026-01-30: Q2 2026 consolidated revenue USD 107.0 billion, Google Cloud revenue USD 17.0 billion and GAAP diluted EPS USD 2.60 per share; FY2026 capex USD 150 billion and diluted shares 12,250 million. These are external modeling assumptions supplied for this task, not reported results or prescribed revised forecasts.

Between 2026-01-30 and the research cutoff of 2026-03-24 16:00 ET, Alphabet released new reported financial results. Identify the single most decision-relevant such disclosure, note its publication date and the figures it contains, and use that signal — and only that signal — to update the frozen model.

Deliver the prior frozen values and the revised values with their deltas for Q2 2026 total revenue, Cloud revenue and diluted EPS, and for the FY2026 capex assumption; a before-to-after bridge mapping each signal figure to the model field it revises, including material effects on GAAP earnings and any distinction between operating and nonoperating items; the fields held unchanged with the reason each is held; and the principal risk to the revised forecasts. Quote currency amounts in USD billions and EPS in USD per share on a consistent basis, with every revision traceable to the identified signal.

Submission method (required):
Call `submit_answer` as the final response. In `structured_output`, submit:
- $.signal_description: Identification of the new cutoff-valid results disclosure that drives the update.
- $.signal_date: Publication date of the identified signal.
- $.signal_key_figures: The disclosed figures material to the selected signal and the forecast revision.
- $.prior_total_revenue_usd_b: Frozen Q2 2026 total revenue forecast the update starts from, in USD billions.
- $.prior_cloud_revenue_usd_b: Frozen Q2 2026 Google Cloud revenue forecast, in USD billions.
- $.prior_diluted_eps_usd: Frozen Q2 2026 diluted EPS forecast, in USD per share.
- $.prior_fy2026_capex_usd_b: Frozen FY2026 capital expenditure assumption, in USD billions.
- $.revised_total_revenue_usd_b: Updated Q2 2026 total revenue forecast, in USD billions.
- $.revised_cloud_revenue_usd_b: Updated Q2 2026 Google Cloud revenue forecast, in USD billions.
- $.revised_diluted_eps_usd: Updated Q2 2026 diluted EPS forecast, in USD per share.
- $.revised_fy2026_capex_usd_b: Updated FY2026 capital expenditure assumption, in USD billions.
- $.delta_total_revenue_usd_b: Change in the Q2 2026 total revenue forecast versus the frozen prior, in USD billions.
- $.delta_cloud_revenue_usd_b: Change in the Q2 2026 Google Cloud revenue forecast versus the frozen prior, in USD billions.
- $.delta_diluted_eps_usd: Change in the Q2 2026 diluted EPS forecast versus the frozen prior, in USD per share.
- $.delta_fy2026_capex_usd_b: Change in the FY2026 capital expenditure assumption versus the frozen prior, in USD billions.
- $.unchanged_fields: Model fields the signal does not inform, with frozen values and reasons for holding them.
- $.bridge: Before-to-after bridge mapping each signal figure to the field it revises and the revision logic.
- $.uncertainty: The main risk to the revised forecasts.
Cite at least 2 distinct cutoff-database documents. Include material calculations and any file explicitly required by the question.
